knownGotchas: setBoundVariableForPaint on a paint that already has opacity set can silently drop the opacity — always bind the variable first, THEN set opacity on the returned paint object as a separate step.

A component INSTANCE created via createInstance() did not automatically inherit a manually-mutated fill.opacity from its main component in one case — verify instance fills explicitly after creating instances from a component whose fill was patched post-creation, don't assume live inheritance for that property.

onboarding.criticalLessonLearned: When reproducing a CSS rotated element (outer flex container with fixed w/h containing a rotated inner element of DIFFERENT natural w/h, centered via flex), the outer container's w/h is the POST-rotation bounding box, not the node's own size. Always extract the natural pre-rotation size from the innermost sized div, set node to that natural size UNROTATED first, position its center to match the outer container's center, THEN apply rotation. Never resize a node to the outer/rotated bounding box dimensions. Also: never hand-guess colors for small multi-color assets (e.g. pagination dots) — download and inspect the actual SVG source, or reuse the asset directly, rather than approximating with a design-system token that might be visually close but wrong.

reconstructionTemplate: Per screen: 1) get_design_context on original nodeId (fileKey Byi9NgQxkBPbmbhU403HSf) to get asset URLs + exact positions/colors/text. 2) For decorative/bespoke visuals (gradients, organic shapes, mockup photos): curl-download each asset URL, upload_assets (batch) into RbX84qKbxppvAy5iypLYP2, then position via use_figma using the x/y/w/h/rotation values from the design-context code. 3) For functional UI (buttons, avatars, badges, status cards): use createInstance() from the matching component in page 4:15 instead of rebuilding from scratch. 4) Validate with get_screenshot after assembly. Cost so far: ~8 MCP calls for one onboarding screen (5 downloads/uploads + 1 assembly script + 1 screenshot, plus the initial get_design_context read). Extrapolated: full ~85-frame app is roughly 500-700 MCP calls — a multi-day effort even on a 200/day plan.
